settings.editor: Hand-Set uncut polki & hydro emerald bridal suites.
Hand-strung baroque Basra pearls & multi-strand rani haars.

Unlike flash electroplating that flakes in 2 months, our Demi-Fine series uses Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD). Titanium-grade 316L stainless steel cores are placed inside a high-temperature vacuum chamber, vaporizing 18-karat real gold onto the molecular surface.

icon_list.text: 10x thicker atomic bonding than conventional gold plating
